details: Cloaking needs the refractive index profile to guide light around a volume; transformation optics gives the math.
The math demands extreme, often lossy materials; losses grow with size and bandwidth.
Broadband visible cloaking of a person would need materials that do not exist and may not be possible.
Thermal camouflage is easier: match apparent temperature and the IR camera is fooled.
